fees.notes: UNITAR publishes only local-student tuition on its programme pages ('Price listed above is applicable to local students only'). EasyUni/Uni Enrol list foreign-student tuition of about MYR 14,000-60,500 depending on programme; 22 legacy/non-listed programmes have no published international fee. See individual programme records. Sources: https://www.unitar.my/programmes/, https://www.easyuni.my/malaysia/unitar-international-university-11409/courses/ (accessed 2026-09-18).
